schema.description: its depot, and the space the crew works in there (the world must say)

depot.source: its depot, and the space the crew works in there (the world must say)

schema.description: the channel that shows the depot, with who's there by name
what the work is (its postings say)
the office of the town that pays its staff, which is sent notice of starters and leavers (the world says; none: no notice is sent)

wear worth a crew's time above this

keeps.why: The round is the works office's own: it makes an entry for each address its crew collects from, and adds to it as homes are built.

takes.title: Staffing direction to the works office

recruit.description: Whether the works office recruits: yes, it advertises and fills the posts it is short of; no, it advertises none and takes nobody on.

posts.description: The most works crew it is to have, where that is fewer than its budget pays for. Left out: as many as the budget pays for.

takes.follows: While a direction with recruit no stands, the works office advertises no post, takes down the advertisements it has out and offers nobody employment. With recruit yes it recruits up to what its budget pays for, or up to posts where that is fewer. Nobody is stood down by it and nobody's pay changes.

takes.title: Collection direction to the works office

every.description: How often each address on the round is to be collected from (a week, a fortnight).

takes.follows: While it stands, the crew collects from each address on the round once in that time, as its hours allow, homes complained about first. With no direction, the office keeps to its own round.

issues.title: Job advertisement
issues.does: How the office takes on staff of its own: it puts the posts on the jobs board at the wage given, for people to apply, and the office then offers employment to those it takes on. It commits no money until someone is taken on.

wage.description: The wage for each pay period.

period.description: The pay period: how often the wage is paid.

posts.description: How many posts this advertisement is for.

account.description: The account the wages are paid from, where the office itself pays them.

issues.title: Payroll notice of a new starter, to the office that pays the organisation's staff
issues.does: Tells the office that pays the organisation's staff that someone has been taken on, with what it needs to set their wage up. It pays nobody by itself: the paying office sets the payment up. Write to that office too, naming the notice: a paper on the organisation's own file is not put in front of it.

agreement.description: The employment agreement, signed by both.

wage.description: The wage for each pay period, before tax.

first_pay.description: The first pay day (a pay period after both signed, unless the agreement says otherwise).

account.description: The account the wage is paid into.

writes.text: Payroll notice, new starter: {employee}, {post}, under employment agreement {agreement}. Pay: {wage} every {period} before tax, into {account}; first pay day {first_pay}, then every {period}. The post is one of those the {@budget_line} line of the adopted budget pays for: the wage is on that line. For the {@payroll_office} office: the wage payment is to be set up from that day.

issues.title: Payroll notice of a leaver, to the office that pays the organisation's staff
issues.does: Tells the office that pays the organisation's staff that someone's employment is ending and when, so that their wage payment ends then. It ends no employment and stops no payment by itself. Write to that office too, naming the notice.

agreement.description: The employment agreement that is ending.

last_day.description: The last day of the employment.

writes.text: Payroll notice, leaver: {employee}, {post}, employment agreement {agreement} ends on {last_day} ({reason}). For the {@payroll_office} office: pay is due to that day, and the wage payment under the agreement is to end then.

issues.title: Docket for waste delivered to the landfill
issues.does: Goes with a load of waste taken to the landfill: what was delivered and how much, which the landfill charges by.

sends.why: The landfill takes the load and charges by the docket.

routines.what: The crew at the depot collects waste from each address on the round as often as the order says, homes complained about first, as far as its hours go, and takes what it has collected to the landfill each week with a docket.
With the hours the round leaves, the crew keeps up the most worn of the town's own assets, and someone is sent to inspect an asset nobody has seen.
The office's counter staff sort the day's post that is routine under this procedure and answer it, each working day, so that the works manager is not brought back for it.

papers.how: a complaint of a collection missed puts the home first on the next round of collection
